items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: But Koetsabiskie (PHONETIC) -- Koetsabiskie wrote and answered Dave Dexter; that's when Dave was writing for the DownBeat.

ctx.x: I remember Dave Dexter reviewed one of the things that Bear did -- we called him Bear because of the record he did, because he made "Jack the Bear", and in this review, Dexter knocked what Blanton was playing, and it's so funny when you really reach a certain point where some other people will take up the fight for you. Blanton and I read it and it didn't mean too much.

But Koetsabiskie (PHONETIC) -- Koetsabiskie wrote and answered Dave Dexter; that's when Dave was writing for the DownBeat. And like it went something like, "How dare you criticize a virtuoso such as Jimmy Blanton. If I had to say anything about the recording that he made, and I have everything he's ever done -- the only thing that I would suggest, because of the way he plays, I would suggest that he should record with a three quarter size bass instead of a full size bass."
